description: This file defines the 'LibraryThingBookDataImport' class which manages a collection of book import data from LibraryThing within the book project. It provides a method to retrieve all imported books as a list.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookDataImport
classes.description: A class that holds a map of LibraryThingBookImport objects and provides a method to convert it into a list.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Returns a list of all LibraryThingBookImport instances stored in the map.
